keyEvents.text: Ronaldo Vieira (San Jose Earthquakes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Beau Leroux (San Jose Earthquakes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! San Jose Earthquakes 1, Houston Dynamo FC 0. Daniel Munie (San Jose Earthquakes) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Beau Leroux following a corner.
First Half ends, San Jose Earthquakes 1, Houston Dynamo FC 0.
Second Half begins San Jose Earthquakes 1, Houston Dynamo FC 0.
Substitution, Houston Dynamo FC. Héctor Herrera replaces Diadié Samassékou.
Substitution, San Jose Earthquakes. Nick Fernandez replaces Beau Leroux.
Substitution, San Jose Earthquakes. Ian Harkes replaces Niko Tsakiris.
Agustin Resch (Houston Dynamo FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Houston Dynamo FC. Nick Markanich replaces Ibrahim Aliyu.
Substitution, Houston Dynamo FC. Matthew Arana replaces Duncan McGuire.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, San Jose Earthquakes. Jack Skahan replaces Eduard Löwen.
Substitution, San Jose Earthquakes. Luka Jovanovic replaces Ousseni Bouda.
Substitution, Houston Dynamo FC. Franco Negri replaces Felipe Andrade.
Benji Kikanovic (San Jose Earthquakes) is shown the yellow card.
Second Half ends, San Jose Earthquakes 1, Houston Dynamo FC 0.
